description_en: Configures balance throttling for a department
description_zh: 客户管理/启用部门余额限流
name: ModelRouterConfigureClientBalance

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to enable balance throttling. Once enabled, this feature cannot be disabled.
parameters.description_zh: 是否启用余额限流，余额一旦开启不可关闭
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable balance throttling. Once enabled, this feature cannot be disabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用余额限流，余额一旦开启不可关闭
parameters.name: enable_balance

parameters.description_en: The balance type. Valid values: `amount` or `tokens`. This parameter is required when you first enable balance throttling and cannot be changed afterward.
parameters.description_zh: 余额类型：amount（金额）/ tokens（token数量），首次启用时必填，一旦设置不可修改
parameters.help_en: The balance type. Valid values: `amount` or `tokens`. This parameter is required when you first enable balance throttling and cannot be changed afterward
parameters.help_zh: 余额类型：amount（金额）/ tokens（token数量），首次启用时必填，一旦设置不可修改
parameters.name: balance_type

parameters.description_en: The initial balance. This parameter is only applicable when you first enable balance throttling.
parameters.description_zh: 初始余额，仅在首次启用时生效
parameters.help_en: The initial balance. This parameter is only applicable when you first enable balance throttling
parameters.help_zh: 初始余额，仅在首次启用时生效
parameters.name: initial_balance
